{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Natural Bridge Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Casper, Wyoming to Douglas, Wyoming.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.blackhillsenergy.com/our-company/delivering-energy/natural-bridge-pipeline|title=blackhillsenergy.com|website=blackhillsenergy.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
*'''Owner: '''Black Hills Gas Distribution LLC<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''35 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.blackhillsenergy.com/our-company/delivering-energy/natural-bridge-pipeline|title=blackhillsenergy.com|website=blackhillsenergy.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''12 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.blackhillsenergy.com/our-company/delivering-energy/natural-bridge-pipeline|title=blackhillsenergy.com|website=blackhillsenergy.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Cost: '''US$54,200,000<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.blackhillsenergy.com/our-company/delivering-energy/natural-bridge-pipeline|title=blackhillsenergy.com|website=blackhillsenergy.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
